# QHEBosonsOverlap

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnDisk` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnDisk/QHEBosonsOverlap`

```text
QHEBosonsOverlap, version 0.01

Usage: QHEBosonsOverlap [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 7)
    -l, --momentum : maximum single particle momentum to study (value must be greater than 1, default value = 10)
    --exact-state : name of the file containing the vector obtained using exact diagonalization
    --test-wavefunction : name of the test wave fuction
    --list-wavefunctions : list all available test wave fuctions
    --use-exact : filen name of an exact state that has to be used as test wave function

Monte Carlo options:
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of Monte Carlo iterations (default value = 10000)
    --display-step : number of iteration between two consecutive result displays (default value = 1000)
    --with-timecoherence : use time coherence between two successive evaluation of the wave function
    --show-details : show intermediate values used for overlap calculation

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
